note: Juneau County park on the Lemonweir River, 3 mi north of New Lisbon off County Road M: 15 rustic sites strung along the wooded park road, with a canoe launch at the far end. Sites are listed for small and medium campers with no lengths posted, so a 23-ft rig's fit is unconfirmed. Picnic shelter, playground, archery range; the Wisconsin Bowhunters' shoot fills the park the first weekend after Labor Day. --Claude
